leadText: (Japanese: Romantic Spice - Legend) is the seventh episode of the second season of POKÉTOON and fifteenth overall. It was first released in Japan on the official Pokémon YouTube channel on October 30, 2024.
plainText:
(Japanese: Romantic Spice - Legend) is the seventh episode of the second season of POKÉTOON and fifteenth overall. It was first released in Japan on the official Pokémon YouTube channel on October 30, 2024.

==Blurb==

==Plot==
A mischievous is seen biting a variety of Pokémon, leaving them angered due to the spiciness all the while it laughs at their expense, much to its 's, Akira, dismay.

A collection of scenes is displayed in quick succession: Capsakid walking under rain with a downtrodden expression, being held by Akira and biting her fingers as she holds back tears, facing another Trainer's , jogging at sunset alongside Akira, sharing a pizza with her, and biting her nose during an argument. Akira then calls Capsakid out for battle, but its biting attacks fail to do meaningful damage to the opposing and it is hit squarely by a beam; with its Trainer's encouragement, Capsakid manages to stand up, but it is ultimately defeated. Akira holds Capsakid in her arms, letting her tears fall, presumably after their loss.

Elsewhere, Akira and Capsakid admire a swarm of flying overhead. A breaks through an iceberg, and Capsakid comes running after it, but falls and tears well in its eyes. Akira extends her hand to Capsakid and asks for them to be friends. The title appears on the screen, then it changes to a scene of Akira with Capsakid on her shoulder standing at the edge of a cliff, overlooking the scenery.
